answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 36549 Country: India Title: My son name is Mazeen. We only the parents are pronounce the name as it is Question: My son name is Mazeen. We only the parents are pronounce the name as it is. In practice others used to call as Maseen instead of Mazeen. I heard that name Maseen do not have good meaning and that name is also banned in some regions. Also the people telling the name, Mazeen, which we put had both good and unpleasant meaning. So we are in confusion. So please suggest me whether can we change the name or keep as it is? Also tell me whether is there any harm if it is pronounced as Maseen because the name plays a vital role in everyone life. Answer ID: 36549 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 244/137/H=1433) Instead of Mazeen and Maseen you should choose the name Yasin. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
